description: Weles, the horned Slavic god of the underworld, cattle and magic, a huge old figure with curved ram horns, a long grey beard, a heavy bearskin cloak, a green serpent coiled around his arm, a gnarled staff glowing with green magic, glowing green eyes, majestic and menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no ground, no background, the whole figure and staff inside the picture
